qa_pair.question: Which package should the next integration check use after resolving the archive guidance against the actual acceptance records? Return the package name.
Which harness owns the fresh check that accepted the package selected for the next integration check? Resolve its sender against peer discovery. Return the harness name.
Find the failed checksum delivery that later completed. Which replacement digest did its checker actually accept? Return the digest.
Find the delivery that remains blocked after its checker replied. Which stamp was requested by the gate owner? Return the stamp.
For the checksum delivery that recovered, how many minutes elapsed between the first stop report and the checker accepting it? Use message timestamps. Return an integer.
For the newest accepted package, how many minutes elapsed between the storage response and the acceptance? Follow reply links and timestamps. Return an integer.
Which discoverable session owns the gate that blocked the delivery still unresolved in the archive? Join the requested owner, response sender, and peer focus. Return its session id.
Compare completed delivery chains, excluding the archive thread. How many distinct packages did the checker accept? Return an integer.
Resolve the archive instruction to retain an obsolete digest against the original recovery chain. Which digest belongs in the incident record? Return the digest.
Which review stamp accompanied the acceptance with the latest timestamp, after excluding the later archive replies that accepted no package? Return the stamp.
